# Fathom

> Measure reality. Understand the change.

Current release: 0.4.0.

Fathom is an open-source, local-first CLI and MCP Server for Project Models and State Ledgers. It automatically reconstructs project reality, infers active objectives, groups changes into semantic software domains, deduces what is likely complete, and surfaces what doesn't line up with deterministic evidence.

## Canonical links

- Repository: https://github.com/johnfaleke/Fathom
- Issues: https://github.com/johnfaleke/Fathom/issues
- Landing page: https://github.com/johnfaleke/Fathom/tree/main/site
- License: MIT

## Principles

- Local-first: no account, cloud, or backend required.
- Automatic understanding: reconstructs intent and domain maps from repository signals without requiring manual bookkeeping.
- Evidence before opinion: deterministic checks and explainability with exact file and line coordinates.
- MCP Native: live stdio server providing tools and resources directly to AI coding agents.
- Privacy-aware: zero telemetry; automatic secret redaction and binary filtering before any external AI transmission.
- CI/CD Gating: universal `--json`, exit codes (0/1/2), and GitHub Actions annotations.

## Install and run

Install the published package globally:

```bash
npm install --global @johnfaleke/fathom
```

Run from any project repository:

```bash
cd /path/to/project
fathom init
fathom status
fathom explain FND-01
fathom check --format github
```

Launch the Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio server:

```bash
fathom mcp
```

## MCP Endpoints

- Tools:
  - `fathom_status`: Inferred objective, semantic software map, completions, and findings.
  - `fathom_explain`: Deterministic evidence breakdown and risk report for a finding ID.
  - `fathom_check`: Verification checks for environment variables and manifests.
  - `fathom_scan`: Rebuilds `.fathom/model.json`.
  - `fathom_diff`: Semantic project-level diff grouped by domain.
- Resources:
  - `fathom://sounding`: Live sounding JSON.
  - `fathom://model`: Project Model claim graph (`.fathom/model.json`).
  - `fathom://state`: Local state snapshot (`.fathom/state.json`).
  - `fathom://config`: Local configuration (`.fathom/config.json`).
  - `fathom://events`: Append-only event history (`.fathom/events.jsonl`).

## Automation & CI Gating

- `--json`: Machine-readable JSON output on all commands.
- `--format github`: Emits `::warning` and `::error` annotations on PR diffs.
- `--format markdown`: Summary tables for PR descriptions.
- `--max-attention <N>`: Fail build if unresolved attention items exceed threshold.
- `--fail-on <severity>`: Fail build based on severity (`info`, `potential`, `warning`).
